prompt: A grid of small squares, each breathing at its own slow rhythm, on a near-black ground with one warm hue. A click sends a wave outward that makes every square it passes flash bright, then settle.
statement: This sketch creates a responsive grid of breathing squares on a dark background, each pulsing with a gentle rhythm. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, a wave expands outward from the point of impact, activating nearby squares and causing them to flash brightly before returning to their steady pulse. The visual effect is subtle yet dynamic, combining organic motion with interactive feedback to create an immersive, tactile experience.
